source_audit.facts: 18 exact source paths; module-only release lookup cannot prove source-only lock. AcquiredGatewayWheelClosure contains raw bodies, not receipts. Generic Xpra source acquisition and unrelated active FixedBuildProfile are not Gateway issuers. No source digest is enrolled by this amendment.

issuer.constructor: from_root_setup(binding, remote_runtime_registry, verified_release, current_actor_verifier, root_journal, pm_toolchain_provider)
issuer.selection: Exact root-issued gateway selection/current remote choice/config/session/transaction/prepared generation/definition/source closure and current selected PM identity. Re-resolve issuer membership each use; original deadline is min retained inputs/session/controller/source/PM. No raw caller mappings, IDs, paths, generic lookup callback or new signing key. Acquisition requires actual Linux ARM64 root and exact reviewed Gateway choice acquisition permission; no service-start download.
issuer.constructor_types: binding: exact RootSelectedInstallationBinding; remote_runtime_registry: exact RootSelectedRemoteRuntimeRegistry; verified_release: exact VerifiedInstallerReleaseReceipt retained by same current session; current_actor_verifier: current session installed RootActorObservation verifier; root_journal: same current selected protected journal; pm_toolchain_provider: exact RootGatewayPMToolchainProvider resolving current binding PM projection. No caller source owner or generic release_member_lookup.

release_source.mapping: Exact release descriptor table maps each logical src/... path below gateway-source/src/...; artifact selector installer-gateway-source:<logical relative path>. These are source-only members, not root-import module receipts. Verified release files descriptor plus current actor/release-held FD proves bytes. Builder source paths use same prefix and source-only role. New release role/layout addition is finite to the 22 listed paths; actual digest/size source-review commit is required before enrollment. Existing reviewed leaf/module pins are unchanged.
release_source.read_current: Reverify exact release/current actor and same selector, open relative to held release dirfd O_NOFOLLOW, fstat regular root-owned immutable descriptor-matching mode/size/inode then bounded hash read. No importer origin required/claimed. No open caller path. Lock additionally <=1MiB.
release_source.closure_gate: The 18 source paths are the audited adapter minimum, not proof of complete runtime import closure. service_connector.py dynamically imports authority/remote_probe_connector_authority.py, which imports authority/remote_connector_authority.py. Add both exact fixed source paths to the finite release cohort if those routes remain reachable; otherwise source-review must prove the fixed gateway runtime cannot enter them. Never assert positive availability from an incomplete closure.

adapter_projection.source_rule: 19 actual application import files (17 current paths plus remote_probe_connector_authority.py and remote_connector_authority.py) are gateway-source; exact requirements-arm64-py314.lock alone gateway-lock; two fixed gateway_runtime_builder.py/gateway_elf.py files gateway-runtime-builder. Builder members are excluded from source_closure_sha256 and bound only by builder_member_receipt_handles and v209 member closure. Regular source files only; no new aliases. Exact closure source audit must validate dynamic imports before positive admission. Existing PM provider owns Python/pip closure separately. Retained private issuer/seal/selection membership authorizes duplication.

wheel_cas.owner: Private child owned by RootGatewaySetupInputReceiptRegistry, same fixed root journal CAS; reuse immutable CAS file primitives, do not call Xpra-only policy issuer.
wheel_cas.acquire: acquire_selected_locked_wheels(selection) -> RootGatewayLockedWheelClosureReceipt. Registry invokes corrected acquisition helper with exact current RootGatewayReleaseSourceMemberReceipt and binding.resolve_current_pm_runtime_projection retained Python/pip members. Helper must consume duplicated held projection FDs/fixed acquisition mounts rather than caller python_path/public VerifiedPMRuntimeSelection; no RootReleaseModuleReceipt cast or duck typing. Fixed source/PM/lock acquisition is pre-build; raw output remains untrusted until issuer readback.
wheel_cas.validation: Exact held lock grammar/name/version/SHA256; no deps/index override/unhashed source/host ambient config. Match exactly one wheel per lock requirement, no extras or duplicates; inspect bounded archive metadata and selected CPython3.14 Linux ARM64 tags independently. Existing max64 wheels,512MiB each,1GiB total,900s acquisition cap retained; cancel/current controller checks and bounded subprocess logs required, no unbounded captured output. TLS verified official PyPI/index+files transport, reject redirects outside reviewed official hosts; no custom proxy/insecure flags. No wheel execution on acquisition. License/dependency evidence must resolve exact wheel contents and reviewed license policy; absent license evidence leaves build unadmitted.
wheel_cas.ingest: Atomic O_EXCL nofollow temporary root-owned0700 journal child; hash bytes during bounded write, fsync, immutable0444 CAS object addressed SHA, reopen/hash/fstat before receipt insertion. Existing object reuse only exact immutable bytes/owner/mode; foreign/conflicting deny. Failed acquisition cleans only owned temp after actual subprocess terminal, retains verified immutable CAS. Raw bodies/dicts never accepted through public receipt API.
wheel_cas.closure_digest: SHA256 ASCII JSON sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False over filename-sorted rows exactly filename,name,version,sha256,size_bytes,platform_tag, matching current acquisition dependency closure. License digest separate; wheel artifact ID gateway-wheel:<sha256> selector only.
wheel_cas.fd: Issuer retains CAS regular-file FDs and reopens/currentness verifies receipt object membership + lock/source/PM/choice/controller before tracked duplication. Duplicate release verifies recorded fd device/inode; do not close recycled caller FD.

source_projection.digest: source_closure_sha256=SHA256 canonical UTF8 sorted compact JSON of logical-path-sorted exact 19 app source plus lock rows {relative_path,artifact_id,sha256,size_bytes,mode}; excludes the two builder members. Builder/toolchain/dependency closure independently bound by v209 member closure and builder_member_receipt_handles. No service_generation_digest invented.
source_projection.integration: Central remote registry retains this sealed issuer projection for gateway and binds its handle/digests into RootSelectedRemoteRoleBuildInputs. v239 package store.resolve_current_source_projection(selection_handle) delegates only to retained exact issuer and revalidates; it does not mint source proof from output/envelope metadata. Adapter consumes existing provider APIs, then central owner independently duplicates/remints actual member FDs under the selected input closure. Full actual build/qualification/materialization/postpublication adoption remains required.
